item.title: PsiQuantum Commits $250,000 to South Chicago Quantum Workforce Development
item.summary: Students participating in hands-on STEM activities. Source: PsiQuantum Photonic quantum computing developer PsiQuantum has announced a $250,000 philanthropic investment to expand local STEM education, higher education programs, and career training in South Chicago. As the anchor tenant of the Illinois Quantum and Microelectronics Park (IQMP), the company is funding workforce development initiatives across surrounding communities [...] The post PsiQuantum Commits $250,000 to South Chicago Quantum Workforce Development appeared first on Quantum Computing Report .
